|`COMPLETED`|All tasks succeeded (or job had zero tasks)|

A job with all tasks in a terminal state is finalized on the next `JobCompletionCron` tick (or immediately, for a job created with zero tasks). See Job completion checks above. `RetryJob` requires the original job to be in a terminal state.
Tasks move through the FSM in `internal/domain/state.go`:
|`PENDING`|Task created and published to Kafka, or reset for retry|
|`RUNNING`|Kafka consumer picked up the message and `TaskExecutor` is running|
|`FAILED`|Execution failed; may transition back to `PENDING` if retries remain|
|`MAX_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED`|All retry attempts used; task is sent to the DLQ topic|
|`CANCELLED`|Parent job was cancelled or superseded by `CancelPrevious`|

Each task also carries a **`sequence_number`** — the 0-based index of the task in the `[]TaskData` slice originally returned by `JobExecutor.Execute`. Use it (or the `GetJobTasks` method) to retrieve tasks in generation order. See Task ordering for why `created_at` is not reliable.
